name: codeburn
purpose: local AI coding spend and usage reports

install.claude: npm install -g codeburn && claude mcp add codeburn -- npx -y codeburn mcp
install.codex: npm install -g codeburn; configure stdio MCP as: npx -y codeburn mcp

data_flow: Reads local session files; its MCP server returns local summaries.

name: graphify
purpose: local codebase graph and queryable report

install.claude: uv tool install graphifyy && graphify claude install
install.codex: uv tool install graphifyy && graphify codex install

data_flow: Builds graph reports from files you choose locally.

name: ponytail

install.claude: claude plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail && claude plugin install ponytail@ponytail
install.codex: codex plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail && codex plugin add ponytail@ponytail

data_flow: Adds local instructions and optional lifecycle hooks.

name: caveman

install.claude: claude plugin marketplace add JuliusBrussee/caveman && claude plugin install caveman@caveman

data_flow: Installs local skills; its full installer can change agent configuration.

data_flow: Routes model traffic through a local proxy and edits agent configuration.
